feedback: Serious misalignments. (1) has_matching_key: after unlocking, Door.toggle clears is_locked, and the required condition is simply carrying a key of the locked door's color; matching the key color to ANY currently locked-or-open door also fires when carrying the key near any unlocked open door of that color, and fails to find the color reference once the locked door is open — the code notes require caching the locked door's color at first labeling, not scanning by is_locked/is_open. Also condition 2 of the RM needs has_matching_key while key_found, but after the key is picked up it is no longer in view, so key_found (latched, ok) — that part is fine — but has_matching_key's door scan can become false when a matching door's state changes, corrupting semantics. (2) target_door_open: 'any open door' is true when ANY door is open, not the locked door; the clause '(not (prev has_matching_key)) is False or any(...)' is a tautology-equivalent hack (the second any repeats the same wrong scan), so it flags every open unlocked hallway door. Must identify THE locked door (cached from first step) and test its is_open. (3) target_room_entered: correct definition is the locked door's cached cell (dx,dy): dx<=ax<=dx+5 and 5*(dy//5)<=ay<=5*(dy//5)+5; instead the candidate (a) matches ANY door whose color equals the carried key's color (color may belong to a non-locked door — environment states another door often shares the color), (b) uses a bogus extra clause approximating a ball-relative box, neither of which is the declared reading; also breaks once the key is dropped (required before picking up the ball). (4) key_found: prev access is correct in shape but 'env.episode_memory["previous_valuation"] and ...' returns falsy dict at first step — acceptable truthiness, though cleaner is prev.get; runtime ok. (5) target_picked_up: fine. Fix: cache locked door color/cell at first labeling; key_found as given; has_matching_key = carrying.key.color == cached L; target_door_open = cached locked door .is_open; target_room_entered = prev latch or cached door-cell room test.
